header: The Bharat (BH) series: the vehicle registration mark that stays valid in every State and Union Territory. This file holds what can be computed: how to read a BH mark ("26 BH 1234 AA"), who is eligible, and the motor vehicle (road) tax. It is pure; nothing typed is stored or sent anywhere. Sources (read in November 2026): the Central Motor Vehicles (Twentieth Amendment) Rules, 2021, G.S.R. 594(E) of 26 August 2021, in force from 15 September 2021 (draft: G.S.R. 276(E) of 6 April 2021), as reproduced with the Press Information Bureau release of 28 August 2021; the change of December 2022 that allowed an ordinary registration to be converted; and published guides of 2025-2026. I quote the rules where they are exact. Where the sources differ or are silent the card says so; the Parivahan portal and the registering authority (the RTO) have the last word.

symbols.name: BH_START
doc: This is the day the BH series came into force.

symbols.name: BH_LETTERS
doc: The letters allowed in the last part of the mark: A to Z without I and O, since they look like 1 and 0.

members.name: yy
doc: Holds the last two digits of the year, as typed ("26").

members.name: shown
doc: Holds the mark as it is written on the plate: "26 BH 1234 AA".

symbols.name: parseBhShape
symbols.sig: export function parseBhShape(raw: string): BhPlate | null
doc: Takes the mark typed with spaces, hyphens or none ("26bh1234aa", "26-BH-1234-AA"), and returns null when it is not shaped like one. I let the letters I and O through so that they can be named.

symbols.name: looksLikeBh
doc: Returns true for a line that is a BH mark; the search line uses it to open the reader at once.

symbols.name: letterSetNumber
symbols.sig: export function letterSetNumber(letters: string): { n: number; of: number } | null
doc: Gives the place of a letter set in the order A to Z, then AA to ZZ (24 + 576 = 600 sets), or null when it uses I or O.

symbols.name: inGroups
doc: Writes a number with Indian grouping (12,34,567), with up to two decimals only when it has them; I do not depend on the machine's locale.

members.name: rate
doc: Holds the rate, in per cent of the invoice price, after the diesel or electric change.

members.name: twoYear
doc: Holds the tax for two years, rounded up to the next rupee.

members.name: annual
doc: Holds the tax for each year from the fourteenth year: half of the two-year tax, rounded up.

members.name: fourteenYears
doc: Seven payments of two years make the first fourteen years.

members.name: steps
doc: Holds the steps of the sum, in words.

symbols.name: bhTax
symbols.sig: export function bhTax(price: number, fuel: BhFuel): BhTax | BhTaxProblem
doc: The two-year tax of rule 51B: invoice price (without GST) x rate x 1.25 x 2 / 15, rounded up to the next rupee. 1.25 x 2 / 15 is 1/6, so it is price x rate / 600. I do it in whole paise so that no rounding of the computer can move the answer by a rupee.

behaviours: a mark is read with spaces, hyphens, none, or small letters
one letter is allowed (the series starts with A, B, C...), three are not, and an ordinary mark is not a BH mark
looksLikeBh is for a short line only, and the samples are all BH marks
the letters are A to Z without I and O: 24 letters
the sets run A..Z (1-24) then AA..ZZ (25-600): A is 1, Z is 24, AA is 25, AB is 26, ZZ is 600, 600 in all; I and O have no place
a mark is read in four parts: year, series, number, letters
the year is 2026 and is the year of registration, not of making
BH replaces the State code; the number is random so none can be chosen; the letters are a counter, not a vehicle-category code
the facts: registered 2026, valid in every State and UT, letter set, tax every two years
a good mark has no warning
a year before the series began is a warning, and the rest is still read
2021 is allowed (the series began that September); a year not yet come is a warning
0000 is noted, because the rule says 0001 to 9999 and one note says 0000
I and O in the letters are refused, naming the digit they look like
a line that is not shaped like a mark says what a mark looks like; nothing typed says nothing
the Ministry's groups are eligible: defence, Central, State/UT, Central PSU, State PSU, private with offices in four or more States
a private firm with fewer than four States, the self-employed and the retired are not in the list
the private firm's proof is Form 60 signed and sealed; the others show the identity card; the refused have no proof
the bands are 8%, 10% and 12%; diesel two points more, electric two points less
Rs 8,00,000 petrol: 8% band, the tax for two years is Rs 10,667 (8,00,000 x 8% x 1.25 x 2 / 15 = 10,666.67, rounded up)
Rs 12,00,000 petrol: 10% band, Rs 20,000
Rs 15,00,000 petrol, Rs 25,00,000 petrol: Rs 25,000 and Rs 50,000
diesel adds two points, electric takes two off: Rs 8,00,000 diesel 10% = Rs 13,334 (13,333.33 rounded up), electric 6% = Rs 8,000
the price is of the band by the words of the rule: below 10 lakh is the first, 10 to 20 lakh (both ends in) the middle, above 20 lakh the last
it is always the one-sixth: the tax is the price x rate / 600, rounded up, for many prices
from the 14th year the tax is yearly, half of the two-year tax, rounded up; the first 14 years are seven payments
the steps are in words and end with the tax
no price, zero, negative, nonsense and an absurd price are refused with a reason
a price with paise does not move the rupee by a computer's rounding: 8,00,000.50 is still 10,667
Indian grouping does not depend on the machine's locale
